manual.metal_constructions.line2: {0}Apart from Treated Wood, processed metals make for common construction blocks.{1}
manual.metal_constructions.line3: All metals can be crafted into blocks and slabs, or plates into sheetmetal as shown in the next page.{0}
manual.metal_constructions.line4: {0}Sheetmetal can be dyed to color it into sixteen shades.{1}
manual.metal_constructions.line5: {0}Metal fencing is the counterpart to standard wooden and treated wooden fencing.{1}
manual.metal_constructions.line6: Unable to burn, metal fencing can be used to effectively keep in hot creatures such as Blazes or burning undead.{0}
manual.metal_constructions.line7: {0}Structural Connectors work similarly to normal connectors, but are purely decorative.{1}
manual.metal_constructions.line8: These connectors can be rotated through several degrees of rotation by rightclicking them with an Engineer's Hammer.{0}
manual.metal_constructions.line9: {0}Structural Connectors will not accept normal wires, instead accepting rope and wire at a maximum range of 32m.{1}
